description: This file defines two classes, EmbedClass and EmbedDetails, which are used to model embedding configuration details and embed query parameters in the BoldBIEmbedSample project.

classes.name: EmbedClass
classes.description: A model class containing properties for embed query string and dashboard server API URL, decorated with DataMember attributes for serialization.

classes.name: EmbedDetails
classes.description: A model class encapsulating various embedding-related properties such as environment, site identifier, server URL, embed secret, user email, embed type, and dashboard ID.
